arxiv-2109-09233.title: (Notebook for PAN at CLEF 2021)
arxiv-2109-09233.creator: Ipek Baris Schlicht, Angel Felipe Magnossão de Paula
arxiv-2109-09233.description: Abstract This paper presents a unified user profiling framework to identify hate speech spreaders by processing their tweets regardless of the language. The framework encodes the tweets with sentence transformers and applies an attention mechanism to select important tweets for learning user profiles.

arxiv-2401-16311.title: Combinatorial identities from an inhomogeneous Ising chain
arxiv-2401-16311.creator: Jessica Jay, Benjamin Lees
arxiv-2401-16311.description: Abstract . We study a family of inhomogeneous Ising chain models along with an equivalent family of nearest neighbour particle systems. By the correspondence between the two families we prove identities of combinatorial significance relating to certain integer and Frobenius partitions. In particular, for certain parameter values we see that one of our identities relates to generating functions for overpartitions.

arxiv-2407-19954.title: A Family of Switching Pursuit Strategies for a Multi-Pursuer Single-Evader Game
arxiv-2407-19954.creator: Marco Casini, Andrea Garulli
arxiv-2407-19954.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Marco Casini, Andrea Garulli. This paper introduces a new family of pursuit strategies for multi-pursuer single-evader games in a planar environment. They leverage conditions under which the minimum-time solution of the game becomes equivalent to that of a suitable two-pursuer single-evader game. This enables the design of strategies in which the pursuers first aim to meet such conditions, and then transition to a two-pursuer game once they are satisfied.

arxiv-2509-20812.title: Teleportation-based filtering for gravitational-wave detectors
arxiv-2509-20812.creator: Yohei Nishino 1,2
arxiv-2509-20812.description: Abstract Employing the principle of quantum teleportation in gravitational-wave detectors provides a method to address technical challenges associated with implementing quantum filters for squeezed-light injection. A recent proposal [Phys. Rev. A 110 , 022601] has shown that an arbitrary number of effective squeezing-angle rotations can be achieved by cascading quantum teleportation, yielding sensitivity equivalent to frequency-dependent pre-filtering.

arxiv-2512-09523.title: Data-driven time-dependent bases for turbulent airfoil wake-extreme vortex gust interactions
arxiv-2512-09523.creator: Shaghayegh Zamani Ashtiani, Kai Fukami1. Department of Aerospace Engineering, Graduate School of Engineering, Tohoku University, Sendai, 980-8579, Japan2. Department of Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science, University of Pittsburgh, PA 15260, USA
arxiv-2512-09523.description: Abstract We analyze interactions between turbulent airfoil wake and an extremely strong gust using a data-driven framework with time-dependent bases. The current approach represents each snapshot with time-varying bases consisting of two-dimensional in-plane modes and one-dimensional spanwise modes, together with a reduced covariance matrix.

pmc-11388102.title: In situ deposition of nanobodies by an engineered commensal microbe promotes survival in a mouse model of enterohemorrhagic E. coli
pmc-11388102.creator: Rajkamal Srivastava, Coral González-Prieto, Jason P Lynch, Michele E Muscolo, Catherine Y Lin, Markus A Brown, Luisa Lemos, Anishma Shrestha, Marcia S Osburne, John M Leong, Cammie F Lesser
pmc-11388102.description: Engineered smart microbes that deliver therapeutic payloads are emerging as treatment modalities, particularly for diseases with links to the gastrointestinal tract. Enterohemorrhagic Escherichia coli (EHEC) is a causative agent of potentially lethal hemolytic uremic syndrome. Given concerns that antibiotic treatment increases EHEC production of Shiga toxin (Stx), which is responsible for systemic disease, novel remedies are needed.

pmc-11407050.title: Protocol for optimized nasal mucosa sample processing to obtain high-quality scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq data
pmc-11407050.creator: Yaling Huang, Yisha Wu, Shikai Han, Qiaoling Wang, Guomingxiu Cong, Zhongzhen Liu, Shuyan Guan, Xiaojuan Huang, Ying Liu, Jianhua Yin, Jinmei Xue, Chuanyu Liu
pmc-11407050.description: SummaryExamining nasal mucosa samples is crucial for nasal cavity disease research and diagnosis. Simultaneously obtaining high-quality data for single-cell transcriptomics (single-cell RNA sequencing [scRNA-seq]) and epigenomics (single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing [scATAC-seq]) of nasal mucosa tissues is challenging. Here, we present a protocol for processing human nasal mucosa samples to obtain data for both scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq.

pmc-12538027.title: Learning Mass Casualty Triage via Role-Play Simulation
pmc-12538027.creator: Nicole Vuong, Martin Morales-Cruz, Drake Dixon, Ayanna Walker, Latha Ganti, Shayne Gue
pmc-12538027.description: BackgroundThe purpose of this educational intervention was to introduce trainees to the core competencies of disaster preparedness/resource allocation/mass casualty incident (MCI) command and event medicine. This innovative learning activity involving trainees from different programs teaches effective techniques of how to apply triage algorithms, such as Simple Triage and Rapid Treatment (START), in a mass casualty event.

pmc-12678268.creator: Corina Vernic, Tudor Paul Tamas, Ion Petre, Sorin Ursoniu
pmc-12678268.description: Intensive care units (ICUs) represent a critical pillar of modern healthcare, combining advanced technologies and specialized care to support organ functions in critically ill patients. pmc-13335108.title: Intrauterine natural killer cell therapy for unexplained recurrent pregnancy failure
pmc-13335108.creator: Hui Zhu, Xianghui Du, Yan Xu, Taishun Li, Biyun Xu, Yonggang Zhou, Fangting Lu, Xianhong Tong, Haixiang Sun, Haiming Wei, Yali Hu, Binqing Fu
pmc-13335108.description: L/RIF related to uterine natural killer (NK) cell abnormalities treated with induced CD49a+ decidual-like NK (idNK) cells from autologous peripheral blood (ChiCTR2100053633). Ongoing pregnancies and live births were achieved in 80% (12/15) of patients after two cycles of idNK cell therapy. Furthermore, no serious treatment-related adverse events were observed among all participants.

pmc-13438098.title: Womens experiences of disrespectful maternity care and its consequences during childbirth in Spain
pmc-13438098.creator: Julián Rodríguez-Almagro, Antonio Hernández-Martínez, Inmaculada Ortiz Esquinas, Ana Rubio Alvárez, Ana Ballesta Castillejos, Miriam Donate Manzanares
pmc-13438098.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Disrespectful care during childbirth may adversely affect women’s well-being and their relationship with health services. This explanatory sequential mixed-methods study explored women’s perceptions and reported consequences of disrespectful treatment during childbirth in Spain. In the quantitative phase, 1,579 women completed the Childbirth Abuse and Respect Evaluation Maternal Questionnaire (CARE-MQ), a validated instrument that assesses self-reported experiences of abuse and/or disrespectful treatment during childbirth. In the qualitative phase, 20 women who reported such experiences participated in semi-structured interviews.

pmc-13670481.title: Temporary Glucose − 6 phosphate dehydrogenase enzyme deficiency, an additional risk factor for invasive fungal infection in immune-compromised AML patients
pmc-13670481.creator: Sampa Ghose, Christine Wilson, Preity Sharma, Surender K Sharawat, Subhrajit Biswas, Ranjit K Sahoo
pmc-13670481.description: Invasive fungal infections (IFI) represent a major threat to acute myeloid leukemia (AML) patients, especially after induction chemotherapy. Intense chemotherapeutic drugs further weaken the immune function of AML patients which increases their susceptibility to life-threatening fungal infection, including invasive aspergillosis (IA).

uslaw-usc-t6-s763.title: 6 U.S.C. § 763 — Transfer of Noble Training Center
uslaw-usc-t6-s763.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t6-s763.description: United States Code, Title 6 (Domestic Security); Chapter 2 (National Emergency Management); Subchapter II (Comprehensive Preparedness System); Part B (Additional Preparedness). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Noble Training Center is transferred to the Center for Domestic Preparedness. The Center for Domestic Preparedness shall integrate the Noble Training Center into the program structure of the Center for Domestic Preparedness.
